native_test_entries: test1: {'time': 1, 'state': {'rgb1': 'off (0,0,0)', 'bargraph1': 'all off'}, 'description': 'Initialization phase. After system start, RGB LED is off (red=0, green=0, blue=0) and bar graph shows all LEDs off.'}

test2: {'time': 4.5, 'state': {'rgb1': 'red intensity 224 (7 steps)', 'bargraph1': '7 LEDs lit'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn1 seven times (each increases red by 32), red intensity is 224 (7*32). RGB LED shows red color with this intensity. Bar graph displays 7 LEDs lit (since 224 corresponds to 7 out of 8 intensity levels).'}

test3: {'time': 8, 'state': {'rgb1': 'red=224, green=224', 'bargraph1': '7 LEDs lit'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn2 seven times (each increases green by 32), green intensity becomes 224. RGB LED shows combined color of red and green (yellow). Bar graph still shows 7 LEDs lit for the most recently adjusted color (green).'}

test4: {'time': 11.5, 'state': {'rgb1': 'red=224, green=224, blue=224', 'bargraph1': '7 LEDs lit'}, 'description': 'After pressing btn3 seven times (each increases blue by 32), blue intensity becomes 224. RGB LED shows combined color of red, green, and blue (white). Bar graph shows 7 LEDs lit for the most recently adjusted color (blue).'}
assumptions: Convert numeric test time to milliseconds; apply changed controls 400ms before observation unless explicit hold duration exists.
Normalized potentiometer positions0..1 map to ADC0..1023.
Every inferred button press is released after200ms unless an explicit hold duration is supplied.
Reference preflight required; no claim that reference consistency proves all prose requirements.
